subject: Invoice delivery gating: temporary signed PDF push while portal onboarding + VAT split
messages:
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@oxbridgeenergy.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: E-invoice delivery + VAT split for multiple EU entities

Hi Kimberly,

We're preparing to pay Redwood for the March usage run (PO 450271). We have two EU entities that need separate VAT treatment: Oxbridge Energy UK Ltd (GB) and Oxbridge Energy NL B.V. (NL). Can you confirm how you can deliver invoices so VAT is applied correctly per entity?

Quick questions:
- Can you push e-invoices directly into our AP portal (preferred)? If so, what format / fields do you require?
- If portal push will take >2 weeks, will Redwood accept a manually emailed, stamped-and-signed PDF for this month's invoice as legally sufficient VAT documentation?
- We will supply VAT certificates (attached) and the PO number — is there any additional field we must populate on the invoice for automated reconciliation?

We're on a tight timeline for this month's close. If portal onboarding is required, we'll start that right away, but we need a fallback for this cycle.

Attachments: vat_certificate_oxbridge.pdf (VAT registration certs)

Thanks,
Sophie Lang
Procurement Lead
Oxbridge Energy
+44 20 7123 4500
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@oxbridgeenergy.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-14T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: E-invoice delivery + VAT split for multiple EU entities

Hi Sophie — thanks for the clear summary and the VAT certs. Looping in Marissa (ops/finance sign-off) and Marcus (revops) so we can coordinate the short and medium-term paths.

Two recommended options:
1) Portal push (preferred): we can deliver UBL/PEPPOL-compatible XML or a lightweight JSON e-invoice with these mandatory fields: remit_entity_name, remit_address, vat_id, PO_number, invoice_date, line_level_vat_tag. We will need the portal endpoint or onboarding contact and a sample mapping for PO->line allocation. I attached a small sample XML (sample_einvoice.xml) showing our required tags. Portal onboarding typically takes 5–10 business days depending on AP side.

2) Temp manual fallback (what you suggested): we can accept a stamped-and-signed PDF for up to 90 days while you finish portal enrollment. Requirements for the PDF fallback: visible PO number on the invoice header, remit entity indicated, VAT registration number printed, and a scanned signature/stamp on the bottom. Finance will require a reply from your AP contact acknowledging acceptance of the PDF as trustworthy evidence.

Action items:
- Sophie: confirm which remit entity should receive the March invoice and provide the exact remit address and PO to use (format: PO-#####).
- Marissa/Marcus: can you confirm internal approval for the 90-day PDF fallback for new EU entities? If yes, I will send the formal fallback language to Sophie and attach it to the order.

Attachments: sample_einvoice.xml

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Accounts (EMEA)
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Lang <sophie.lang@oxbridgeenergy.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Timothy Grant <tim.grant@oxbridgeenergy.com>, Oliver Price <oliver.price@oxbridgeenergy.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: E-invoice delivery + VAT split for multiple EU entities

Kimberly — appreciate the quick turnaround. We will proceed with the portal enrollment but need the March invoice now. Details below:

Remit entity for March invoice: Oxbridge Energy NL B.V.
Remit address: Keizersgracht 123, 1015 CJ Amsterdam, Netherlands
VAT ID: NL123456789B01
PO: PO-450271
AP contact: tim.grant@oxbridgeenergy.com (cc'd)

Tim confirms we can accept a stamped PDF as interim evidence; he attached the VAT certs again to ensure you have both entities on file. Can Redwood ensure the invoice_date can be set to 31-Mar-2027 (close date) rather than generation date? That aligns with our internal cut.

Also: will the emailed PDF need any additional metadata (email subject line or separate CSV) for automated ingestion into our AP system while the portal is being stood up?

Thanks — we'll await your formal fallback wording and the sample XML mapping.

Best,
Sophie
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Approve 90-day signed PDF fallback for Oxbridge (NL entity)

Marissa/Marcus —

Summary: Oxbridge (NL) needs the March invoice delivered this cycle. They will enroll in our portal but asked for a stamped PDF fallback for up to 90 days. PO is PO-450271. They also asked that invoice_date be 2027-03-31.

Proposed fallback language to send to customer (for your review):
"Redwood Inference will provide an emailed, scanned PDF invoice as interim evidence of tax documentation for a maximum period of 90 calendar days while Oxbridge Energy completes portal onboarding. The PDF must include the PO number, remit entity and VAT registration number. Redwood reserves the right to require electronic portal delivery after the onboarding window. Oxbridge agrees that the stamped PDF will be accepted by Redwood Finance as valid VAT documentation for payment purposes for the duration of the fallback window."

Operational notes:
- AP ingestion: please request the vendor include a one-line CSV with each emailed invoice containing: invoice_number, invoice_date, PO_number, remit_entity, total_gross, total_vat. That makes reconciliation trivial.
- Legal: do we need any contract amendment to accept signed PDFs temporarily? My read is no formal contract change but we should log the fallback in the customer record. I attached a draft fallback memo for signature.

Please sign off or propose edits; Sophie is waiting.

Attachments: signed-fallback-proposal.docx

Thanks,
Kim
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-18T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Approve 90-day signed PDF fallback for Oxbridge (NL entity)

Kim — this is OK to proceed with one small amendment: require that the PO number appear on the very first page header (clear to OCR) and that a copy of the emailed invoice is automatically routed to ap-inbox-eu@redwood.com for recordkeeping. Otherwise approve.

Please send the fallback language to Sophie with that tweak, request the one-line CSV for ingestion, and confirm you will schedule the portal invite with our onboarding team next week.

Thanks — Marissa
VP, Customer Success Operations
Redwood Inference
